observations.status: Mechanism implemented; required source validation gates passed.
mechanism_coverage: Dates, metadata and sessions do not split otherwise identical named-model groups.
Changes to all declared conditions, source, measurement and capability separate evidence.
Unavailable model identities remain session-scoped; native requests do not borrow the service model identity.
Approval waits retain the proposing model identity and existing permission controls.
Matching evidence survives restart, reindex, backup and restore.
Reviews require explicit acknowledgement of a current preview and readable source-bound evidence.
Missing support, conflicting boundaries, changed artifacts and stale previews cannot apply.
Duplicate reviewed outcomes count once; revocation changes future eligibility only.
Original records and historical forecast scores remain unchanged.
Rust and Nibli reject invalid graph cases; valid controls and native inspect-first recovery pass.
Pending and inconclusive outcomes are excluded, with a deterministic 32-outcome window.
development_failures: The first grouped fixtures exposed unsupported predicate names in the pinned Nibli vocabulary; the checker was rewritten using existing predicates without changing the engine pin.
The first full CI attempt stopped on Clippy nonminimal_bool; the expression was corrected and both complete gates subsequently passed.
limitations: Existing sandbox-dependent tests return early because the bwrap workspace sandbox cannot run here; a focused nocapture run confirmed this limitation.
Desktop code was compiled and tested; no interactive visual UI inspection was performed.
The archive check was restarted with the same criteria in an optimized build after the debug run remained CPU-bound; the superseded debug process was terminated.
Content digests establish reviewed source identity, not the truth of human comparability judgments.
Native grouping uses the existing broad execution-operation categories, not task correctness.
These are mechanism fixtures and an isolated compatibility experiment, not independent evidence of improved task performance.
observations.deployment: Source branch only; running service, selected model, permissions and NixOS unchanged.
